Direct cast fully matches but no guilt message is recorded. Inspect the real floor and inventory after attributes to distinguish actual animation from deferred/state setup; do not infer historic branch reach from RNG creation alone. Source makemon1168 explains the newt corpse fallback: debug_mongen suppresses ordinary animation creation even though explicit wizgenesis bypasses it. Restore monster generation before a fresh historic newt statue cast; prior history remains valid setup miss and no guilt claimed. Source reveals this cheap corrected route. C590 confirms debug_mongen toggled off; actual new historic newt statue is l. Drop l and cast down, with actual animation/guilt witness required.
